mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate trend compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trend declines for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 5.0% for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances, or interaction effect p>0.05 in 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained economies (INDPRO annual growth <0.5%), a decline in industrial production signals manufacturing weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline occurs in supply-constrained economy but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or regime-specific Rank IC <0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: GDPC1 shows positive quarterly growth but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation remains above 3.0% for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal monetary tightening with labor weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise for 2 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances, or interaction effect p>0.05 in 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (high GDP growth, low unemployment), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market cooling, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS decline occurs in late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth >2.5% and UNRATE <4.0%) but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or regime-specific Rank IC <0.03 over 3 years.
